# Astronaut input fixture / 输入图片来源

`astronaut.png` is the public-domain NASA astronaut photograph distributed by scikit-image. It is an input fixture, not a generated output or bundled model asset. / 此 NASA 公共领域照片来自 scikit-image，仅用于开发输入验证，不是模型输出，也不进入 APK。

Source and attribution: [scikit-image astronaut data documentation](https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.astronaut). The original image is credited to NASA. Model outputs are separately labelled with their source and execution boundary.
